analogy.rationale: Protein phosphatase inhibitors block dephosphorylation, indirectly increasing phosphoprotein signaling, so kinase inhibitors that reduce phosphorylation should partially oppose or share downstream phospho-signaling programs. Other phosphatase-related classes such as ATPase and calcineurin inhibitors share nucleotide-binding or phosphatase-family features but have weaker transcriptional overlap.
